title: Greenhouse Flora Codex
premise: A long breeding drama in the central greenhouse. Breeder Fang Zhou and apprentice Ayou guard the glass grafting knife; Ayou and Abai look nearly alike but wear different armbands; after the rail watering cart overturns and is scrapped it must be avoided; phenology log, count memory, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_breeder: A forty-year-old greenhouse breeder in a straw sun hat and linen work coat, pruning shears at the waist, careful eyes.
states.allergy_limp: The same Fang Zhou: eyes swollen red after a pollen allergy, limping on a broken bamboo pole, linen work coat dusted with medicinal powder.
states.dead_on_cold_bed: Fang Zhou lies still on the cold-bed duty cot with eyes closed, linen work coat covering his chest, pruning shears set beside the bed.

states.young_apprentice: A fifteen-year-old apprentice girl in an indigo apron, turquoise stud in the left ear, chlorophyll stains on her fingertips.
states.adult_gardener: A woman gardener in her early twenties, still in indigo apron and turquoise stud, upright bearing, cultivar tags pinned at the cuff.

states.intact: A grafting knife with glass set in the handle, blade snow-bright, fine leaf-vein etching on the grip.
states.nicked_blade: The same glass grafting knife with a nick in the blade, a crack in the glass handle, leaf-vein etching dusty.
states.resharpened: The glass grafting knife has been resharpened; the nick filled, handle crack glued, edge a little shorter.

states.intact: A waterproof-covered phenology log recording bloom dates, temperature-humidity curves, cutting batches, and survival rates.
states.dew_stained_blurred: The same phenology log soaked through by roof dew, cover wrinkled, temperature-humidity curves blurred into one smear.

states.intact: A watering cart that runs along greenhouse rails, tank painted with the greenhouse number, rotatable nozzle, rail wheels seated on the steel track.
states.overturned_scrapped: The rail watering cart has overturned and been scrapped; tank dented, nozzle twisted, number paint peeling, rail wheels fallen off.

states.young_rival: A young nursery worker whose face closely matches Ayou's, but wearing a silver-gray armband and rice-white apron, expression cool.
states.disguised_return: After a change of look Abai still wears the silver-gray armband; a twig scratch on the cheekbone, rice-white apron swapped for a gray-green smock.

E7.name: central greenhouse
E7.appearance: An arched central greenhouse, glass beaded with fine mist, tall tropical plants and seedling racks lining both sides of the aisle.

E8.name: seedbed zone
E8.appearance: A seedbed zone under shade netting, trays in neat rows, soil damp, white cultivar tags standing in dense lines.

E9.name: shade corridor
E9.appearance: A shade corridor linking the greenhouse, vines hanging down, moss in the brick seams, cart tracks clear on the floor.

E10.name: abandoned cold bed
E10.appearance: An abandoned brick cold bed, one corner of the roof collapsed, water pooled in the bed frame, weeds and old seedling pots crowded together.

E11.name: Fang brass plaque
E11.appearance: A copper plaque nailed to the greenhouse doorpost, carved with Fang Breeding and the year, edges smeared with dry mud.

E12.name: label clips
E12.appearance: Three colored plastic label clips holding cultivar-name cards, hung on a seedbed bamboo pole.

E13.name: hand spray cart
E13.appearance: A hand-pushed spray cart with no rail wheels, spray tank strapped to the frame—nothing like the rail watering cart.

E14.name: garden director's aide
E14.appearance: A lean garden director's aide also in a straw sun hat, but with a park badge on the chest and a tablet checklist in hand, build close to Fang Zhou's.

E15.name: grow lights
E15.appearance: A row of five purple grow lights hung under the central-greenhouse beams, shades clear, lighting the seedling racks.

E16.name: temp-control bells
E16.appearance: Two temperature-control alarm bells hung inside the greenhouse door beam, metal shells chalky white, shrill when overheated.

E17.name: Qingqing
E17.appearance: A flower-selling girl from the nursery, light-brown apron; at a glance much like young Ayou, but wearing anti-fog goggles and shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: fake grafting knife
E18.appearance: A fake grafting knife shaped like the glass grafting knife, but with an ordinary wooden handle and no leaf-vein etching.

E19.name: substrate-bag cart
E19.appearance: A flat cart piled with substrate bags, no rail wheels and no rotatable nozzle—definitely not the rail watering cart.

features.E2: Ayou: indigo apron, turquoise ear stud, chlorophyll stains on fingertips.
features.E6: Abai: face nearly identical to Ayou, but silver-gray armband and rice-white apron.

scenes.setting: Central greenhouse at dusk (introduce five grow lights · two temp-control bells)
actions: At dusk, greenhouse breeder Fang Zhou pushes open the glass door into the central greenhouse and sets the glass grafting knife on the sterilization tray.

actions.action: Five grow lights shine under the central-greenhouse beams; Fang Zhou checks each lamp distance in turn so tender leaves are not scorched.
Two temp-control bells hang inside the door beam; Fang Zhou lightly taps the shells to confirm the alarm wires are not loose.

actions: Fang Zhou takes up the glass grafting knife and cuts a smooth slanted wound at the rootstock bench.
Fang Zhou opens the waterproof-covered phenology log and records today's temperature and humidity, cutting batch, and bloom nodes.

actions.action: He looks up, counts the five grow lights under the beams, and writes the seedling-rack height into the phenology log.

actions: Fang Zhou closes the phenology log and sets the glass grafting knife beside the sterile gauze for the next rootstock.

scenes.setting: Seedbed greets the apprentice (introduce label clips)
actions: In the seedbed zone at dawn, Fang Zhou greets young Ayou pushing the rail watering cart; mist drifts slowly along the steel rails.

actions.action: Ayou parks the rail watering cart beside the trays and checks nozzle angle and rail-wheel position.
Fang Zhou clips three label clips onto the bamboo pole and teaches Ayou to tell cuttings, seedlings, and grafts apart.
Ayou crouches to clear mud flecks from the rail watering cart nozzle; fine substrate sticks to her cuff.

actions: In the shade corridor, Abai in a silver-gray armband glances back from behind the vines; the profile almost like Ayou.
Abai holds a tray of unregistered seedlings; the rice-white apron brushes damp wall bricks.
Abai leaves along the corridor cart tracks, avoiding the glass glare of the central greenhouse.
In the seedbed zone, Ayou and Abai brush past—one in an indigo apron, one in a silver-gray armband.
Ayou steadies the turquoise stud; Abai looks down and smooths the rice-white apron; two similar faces turn toward the tag row at once.
They walk to different seedling racks; white tags between the trays split their backs.
Months later on a muggy night, Fang Zhou patrols the central greenhouse alone; the glass grafting knife lies on the sterilization tray.

actions.action: Condensed dew from the roof drips into the phenology log; the temperature-humidity curves blur into one smear.

actions: Fang Zhou spreads the phenology log before a fan to dry and wipes water beads from the glass grafting knife handle.
Through the long bloom season, Fang Zhou cuts rootstock wounds and aligns cambium every day in the central greenhouse.
In the plum-rain season, glass panels fog over; Fang Zhou moves trays row by row to ventilated spots.
At high summer noon he opens the skylight to cool tropical plants; the grow lights go dark for a while.
At autumn potting, Fang Zhou marks seedlings with whitened roots for the next grafting round.
On New Year's Eve only the pump hums low; Fang Zhou alone records the last surviving batch.

scenes.setting: Seedbed patrol (hand spray cart false friend)
actions: At daybreak Fang Zhou patrols the seedbed zone; the rail watering cart sits on the steel rails, nozzle aimed at tray centers.

actions.action: He crouches to check the rail watering cart's rail wheels, nozzle, and tank number.
Fang Zhou returns to the bamboo pole and confirms those three label clips still hold cultivar cards.
A hand spray cart is pushed through the seedbed zone; it has no rail wheels, only a round spray tank on its back.

scenes.setting: Hail smashes the house (knife nicked · watering cart overturns)
actions: Afternoon hail pounds the glass roof; the central greenhouse panels ring with dense brittle cracks.

actions.action: Fang Zhou clutches the glass grafting knife and rushes toward the seedbeds; the blade hits a fallen iron rack and a clear nick bursts out.
The rail watering cart slides along the rails under broken glass panels; hail makes the nozzle swing wild.
The rail watering cart hits a lifted rail, overturns, and is scrapped; tank dented, nozzle twisted.
Fang Zhou grips the nicked glass grafting knife and first moves seedling trays away from the shattered glass one by one.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (rail watering cart indirect reference · grow-light long-range)

actions.action: The day after the hail, Fang Zhou writes the time the rail watering cart overturned and was scrapped on a blank phenology-log page.
The fallen nozzle of the rail watering cart hangs by the greenhouse wall; Fang Zhou tags it with the accident batch on label paper.
Fang Zhou rubs the rail watering cart tank number into the phenology log, reminding Ayou to check the rails first later.
The five grow lights under the beams still burn; Fang Zhou reads the rail watering cart accident record by purple light.
The nick of the glass grafting knife is wrapped in gauze; Fang Zhou adds another line of rail watering cart loss to the log margin.

scenes.setting: Resharpening (third state · fake grafting knife false friend)
actions: Weeks later Fang Zhou brings the park knife smith to resharpen the glass grafting knife on the central-greenhouse workbench.

actions.action: The smith first sets out a fake grafting knife for comparison—similar shape, but no leaf-vein etching on the wooden handle.

actions: Fang Zhou watches the grindstone slowly eat away the nick; the crack in the glass handle is filled with clear adhesive.

actions.action: After resharpening, the glass grafting knife edge is a little shorter but keen again; Fang Zhou tests a flat cut on scrap wood.

scenes.setting: False friends: substrate-bag cart and garden director's aide

actions.action: A substrate-bag cart is pushed into the seedbed zone, piled with coir bags, no rail wheels and no rotatable nozzle.
The garden director's aide steps beside Fang Zhou, also in a straw sun hat, but the park badge and tablet in hand are unmistakable.
The garden director's aide points at the substrate-bag cart to check replant counts; Fang Zhou slips the resharpened glass grafting knife back into its sheath.

scenes.setting: False friend: Qingqing who resembles Ayou

actions.action: Flower-selling Qingqing pushes a basket past; under the light-brown apron her profile at a glance looks like young Ayou.
Qingqing takes off her anti-fog goggles to wipe them; once Fang Zhou sees clearly he only tells her to skirt the trays being transplanted.
Years later at dusk, Fang Zhou's eyes swollen red from pollen allergy, he limps on a broken bamboo pole to the abandoned cold bed.
Two old temp-control bells still hang in the abandoned cold-bed door beam; Fang Zhou stops to hear them chime in the wind.

actions: Fang Zhou presses his palm to the water-pooled cold-bed frame, as if saying goodbye to this greenhouse.

actions.action: By day, adult Ayou returns along the shade corridor, new cultivar tags pinned to the indigo apron.

actions: Ayou steadies allergy-limping Fang Zhou by the abandoned cold bed and takes his pruning shears.

actions.action: By the cold-bed duty cot, Ayou holds Fang Zhou's withered hand and hears him pass on the grow-light timer.
Fang Zhou's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies on the cold bed.
Fang Zhou's straw sun hat still hangs behind the cold-bed door; Ayou pats dry pollen from it.
Adult Ayou re-nails the Fang brass plaque to the central-greenhouse doorpost; Fang Zhou's year is still carved on it.
Ayou traces Fang Zhou's name on the Fang brass plaque, then sets the resharpened glass grafting knife at the center of the workbench.
Disguised Abai walks in from outside the cold bed, silver-gray armband still on the cuff, and locks eyes with Ayou across the tray rack.

actions: Ayou and Abai stand side by side before the cold bed—one steady in indigo apron, one in a worn gray-green smock.

actions.action: The shot returns years—that girl in an indigo apron learning to clip cultivar cards beside the trays appears again.

anchor.phrase: the girl learning to clip cultivar cards beside the trays

actions.action: The opening moment returns—that small clear-handled knife first cuts a flat slanted wound on a rootstock.

anchor.phrase: the clear-handled knife that first cut a flat slanted wound at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the early shade corridor; a figure in a silver-gray armband and rice-white apron skims past behind the vines.

anchor.phrase: the figure in a silver-gray armband in the early shade corridor

actions.action: Again the old night of five purple lamps under the beams lighting the seedling racks.

anchor.phrase: the old night of five purple lamps under the beams lighting the seedling racks

actions.action: Back to the tray zone under shade netting at first meeting; the wet-soil smell remains.

anchor.phrase: the tray zone under shade netting at first meeting

actions.action: Ayou opens the dew-stained blurred phenology log and stands in the central greenhouse to re-schedule cutting batches.
The five grow lights under the beams still burn; Ayou looks up and finishes counting before pushing the seedling rack back.
Those three label clips on the bamboo pole still hold cultivar cards; Ayou begins a new grafting round with the resharpened glass grafting knife.
